_rationale: max_single_file_bytes = 50MB: tests/fixtures/valid/** knowledge/manifest fixtures are all under 4KB and docs/implementation-spec/04-knowledge-platform.md describes the PoC corpus as small text/PDF/docx documents (tens of KB to low tens of MB) — 50MB comfortably covers a large scanned PDF while still bounding memory used per file during the streaming read in create_asset. max_total_request_bytes = 150MB (3x the single-file cap): lets a registration attach a few large files (e.g. a source doc + supporting attachments) without effectively re-allowing an unbounded request via many files, and stays far below what would risk exhausting portal-api process memory or disk in one request. max_file_count = 20: registrations in this repo (P05 wizard, fixtures) attach at most a handful of files (a manifest-referenced template plus source docs); 20 gives headroom for a knowledge asset with a spreadsheet of supporting attachments while still making an accidental or abusive bulk-upload attempt fail fast on count before any bytes are read. rejected_extensions reuses bundle-install-policy.json's executable_extensions + archive_extensions verbatim (see schema description for why: no legitimate inbound asset registration needs an executable or nested archive, and matching the outbound Desktop Bundle install policy avoids leaving registration as the weaker of the two checkpoints).
